info.title: 2s — the (most) everything API
info.description: The (most) everything API for AI agents: 575+ pay-per-call endpoints on one origin. More live, ground-truth data than any other x402 service — public records, finance & SEC filings, crypto & web3, security & CVEs, legal, medical, weather, geocoding, and B2B/EDI. A full AI gateway: chat, image, and multi-model consensus across every major model, priced per request in the 402 before you pay. And agent infrastructure with no account: wallet-scoped storage (kv/docs/vectors/files), locks, queues, scheduled callbacks, pub/sub, and watchers that push signed webhooks when the world changes. Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana via x402 — no API keys, no signup, no subscription. The first x402 API with upto billing: on AI endpoints, authorize the quoted max and settle only your actual usage. Try before you buy: add ?trial=1 (or header X-2s-Trial: 1) to any endpoint for one free real call per endpoint per hour — no wallet needed. New endpoints land constantly.
info.x-guidance: Pay-per-call REST API for AI agents — hundreds of endpoints returning ground-truth data (US public records, company & legal identifiers, finance/SEC, crypto/web3, security & CVEs, medical codes, weather & geocoding, agriculture, energy, maritime, music, and more). Every endpoint is paid per call in USDC via x402 (Base or Solana) — no API key, no signup. Call any endpoint with no auth to get a 402 PaymentRequirements envelope, sign it (EIP-3009 on Base, partial SPL transfer on Solana), and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Add ?trial=1 for one free real call per endpoint per hour to test before paying. To discover the right endpoint: GET https://2s.io/api/directory for the full catalog, or GET https://2s.io/api/search/endpoints?q=<natural-language task> for a ranked match. Per-call price is on each operation as x-payment-info (from $0.001). Batch up to 50 calls behind one payment via POST https://2s.io/api/batch/run.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required. Body contains the x402 PaymentRequirements envelope with a multi-network accepts array; the per-call price is in accepts[].amount (and on the operation as x-2s-price). Sign for whichever rail you hold USDC on (EIP-3009 for Base, partial SPL transfer for Solana) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (X-PAYMENT also accepted for v1 clients).

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not allowed — see `Allow` header for the supported method.

TrialMode.name: trial
TrialMode.description: Try before you buy. Set to 1 for one free real call per endpoint per hour — no wallet or payment needed — to verify the endpoint before paying. Equivalent to sending the "X-2s-Trial: 1" request header. Works on every endpoint.

x402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402Payment.description: x402 protocol v2: base64-encoded PaymentPayload. Call any paid endpoint without auth to receive a 402 with a multi-network PaymentRequirements envelope. Sign for either rail: EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization (Base USDC) OR a partial SPL token transfer (Solana USDC). Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. X-PAYMENT is also accepted for v1 buyer clients. See https://x402.org.

Source.description: Provenance of the data: upstream provider, source URL, and license.

license.description: License / usage terms for the data.

CallMeta.description: Per-call meta envelope — endpoint id, cost, caller kind, settlement details.

X402PaymentRequiredV2.description: x402 v2 PaymentRequired envelope. Pick any entry from accepts[], sign for that rail, retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

accepts.description: Payment requirement options, one per supported network (Base USDC, Solana USDC).

amount.description: Price in atomic asset units (USDC has 6 decimals).

extra.description: Rail-specific extras (EVM: EIP-712 domain name/version; Solana: feePayer).

extensions.description: Optional discovery metadata (e.g. bazaar input/output schemas).

post.summary: What's happened in a given topic since a given date?
post.description: What's happened in a given topic since a given date? Pass a free-text topic + ISO date; receive a deduplicated, ranked list of recent events drawn from US federal regulations, US House + Senate roll-call votes, academic papers (arXiv + PubMed + Semantic Scholar), and federal court opinions. Each event includes title, 1-2 sentence summary, date, source label, source URL, and a 1-5 significance score. Designed so an AI agent can spend one call to catch up on a domain since its LLM training cutoff. LLM-backed source routing and synthesis.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [delta] (one knowledge-delta document: query echo, sourcesQueried, deduplicated+ranked events); total = 1; meta.rawHits = raw hit count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

topic.description: Free-text domain. Examples: "oncology immunotherapy", "Rust language ecosystem", "SEC enforcement against crypto exchanges".

since.description: Earliest date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically the agent's LLM training cutoff date.

get.summary: US Drought Monitor severity for a county (5-digit FIPS) or...
get.description: US Drought Monitor severity for a county (5-digit FIPS) or state (2-letter code). Returns the weekly percent of area in each drought category — None, D0 (Abnormally Dry), D1 (Moderate), D2 (Severe), D3 (Extreme), D4 (Exceptional) — newest week first, plus the worst category present each week. Keyless, public-domain (NDMC/USDA/NOAA). This is the official metric behind USDA disaster-program eligibility; use for crop-risk, water, and insurance reasoning.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = weekly drought breakdowns (newest first); total = week count; meta carries area + areaType.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: USDA NASS QuickStats - authoritative US agricultural...
get.description: USDA NASS QuickStats — authoritative US agricultural statistics: crop yields, acreage, production, livestock inventory, and prices received. Filter by commodity (e.g. CORN, SOYBEANS, CATTLE), year (or year__GE/year__LE range), state (2-letter), county, statistic category (YIELD, PRODUCTION, AREA HARVESTED, PRICE RECEIVED), and aggregation level (NATIONAL/STATE/COUNTY). Returns normalized rows with value + unit. QuickStats caps results at 50,000 rows, so narrow broad queries (a 400 RESULT_TOO_LARGE tells you to add filters). Public-domain federal data.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = matching NASS statistics rows; total = row count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat completions across every frontier...
post.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions across every frontier model on one endpoint — GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral and ~290 more. POST { model, messages, max_tokens?, temperature?, top_p?, stop? } and get back a standard chat.completion (choices[].message + usage). Pay per call in USDC via x402 — no accounts, no provider keys, no subscriptions. Price scales with the model and max_tokens and is quoted in the 402. List selectable models at GET /api/ai/models.

200.description: OK

model.description: Gateway model id, e.g. openai/gpt-5, anthropic/claude-opus-4.8, google/gemini-3-pro-preview. Full list: GET /api/ai/models.

post.summary: Zero-shot text classification.
post.description: Zero-shot text classification. POST { text, labels[], multiLabel? }. Assigns the text to one of your labels (or several when multiLabel=true) with a confidence score and a one-line rationale. No training data needed — define the labels at call time. Great for routing, tagging, triage, and intent detection.

200.description: Normalized: items = [classification].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Ask several frontier models the same question and get one...
post.description: Ask several frontier models the same question and get one synthesized answer. Choose a preset council — fast (3 quick models), balanced (3 strong models with a peer-refine round), or deep (5 models plus refine) — or supply your own set of 2–8 models. A chairman model merges the responses into a single consensus with a confidence score and any points of dissent, and each member’s individual answer is returned alongside. Price scales with the council size and answer length, and is quoted up front in the 402. Models auto-resolve to their latest available version; any unavailable model simply drops out (at least 2 are needed).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [the consensus result]; total = 1. meta carries the mode, chairman model, and how many members answered.

confidence.description: 0–1 confidence; high when the council agreed.

agreement.description: One-line note on what the council agreed on.

dissent.description: Notable disagreements or points one model added; empty on full agreement.

models.description: Each council member and its individual answer (null if it did not respond).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

prompt.description: The question to put to the council.

mode.description: Preset council. Default balanced. Ignored if `models` is given.

models.description: Custom council of 2–8 gateway model ids, e.g. ["openai/gpt-5","anthropic/claude-opus","google/gemini-3-pro"] (overrides `mode`). Full selectable list + live prices: GET /api/ai/council/menu.

maxTokens.description: Max output tokens per model. Default 640.

post.summary: Describe an image. POST { imageUrl, instruction? }. Returns...
post.description: Describe an image. POST { imageUrl, instruction? }. Returns { imageUrl, altText (5-15 word accessibility text), description (2-3 sentences), contentType (photograph|illustration|screenshot|diagram|document|mixed|other), text (verbatim OCR transcription, "" if none), mainObjects[], dominantColors[] (hex) }. Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. 1MB image size cap.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [description] (one structured image description: altText, description, OCR text, main objects, dominant colors); total = 1.

text.description: Verbatim OCR transcription, "" if no text present.

dominantColors.description: Hex color codes (e.g. "#1a3b5f") of dominant colors.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image (≤1MB).

instruction.description: Optional caller-supplied focus hint, e.g. "describe the chart axes".

post.summary: Named-entity recognition.
post.description: Named-entity recognition. POST { text }. Extracts people, organizations, locations, dates, money, products, laws, events and more — each with a standard type and mention count. For knowledge extraction, redaction prep, and document indexing.

200.description: Normalized: items = [{ entities, count }].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Extract structured data from a webpage.
post.description: Extract structured data from a webpage. POST { url, schema, instruction? }. The schema is a JSON Schema object (top-level type:"object") describing the shape you want back; output is guaranteed to conform. Returns { url, finalUrl, extracted, meta:{ truncated } }.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [extraction] (one object: the schema-conforming extracted data, source URLs, truncation flag); total = 1.

extracted.description: The extracted object, conforming to the caller-supplied JSON Schema.

truncated.description: True if the source page was truncated before extraction.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Generate images from a text prompt across the gateway's...
post.description: Generate images from a text prompt across the gateway’s image models (gpt-image, Gemini image, FLUX, Grok Imagine, …) on one endpoint. POST { model, prompt, n?, size? } → OpenAI-style { created, data: [{ b64_json }] }. Pay per call in USDC via x402 — no accounts or provider keys. Priced per model from $0.03/image (quoted in the 402). List models at GET /api/ai/models.

200.description: OK

model.description: Gateway image model id, e.g. openai/gpt-image-1, google/gemini-3-pro-image, black-forest-labs/flux-1.1-pro.

post.summary: Content moderation. POST { text }. Flags content across...
post.description: Content moderation. POST { text }. Flags content across categories — hate, harassment, sexual, sexual/minors, violence, self-harm, dangerous, illicit — with a per-category boolean and 0..1 severity score, plus an overall flagged verdict. For UGC filtering, trust & safety, and pre-publish checks.

200.description: Normalized: items = [{ flagged, categories, scores }].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: OCR + layout extraction.
post.description: OCR + layout extraction. POST { imageUrl, instruction? }. Returns verbatim transcribed text in reading order, any detected tables as markdown, the primary language, and a handwriting flag. For reading receipts, forms, screenshots, scanned pages, and labels. JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP.

200.description: Normalized: items = [OCR result].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

instruction.description: Optional steering, e.g. "only the table" or "preserve line numbers".

post.summary: PII detection. POST { text }. Finds personally identifiable...
post.description: PII detection. POST { text }. Finds personally identifiable information — names, emails, phones, addresses, SSNs, credit cards, bank/IP/passport/DOB and more — returning each finding with its type and exact substring so you can redact it. For compliance, logging hygiene, and data-minimization before storing or sending text.

200.description: Normalized: items = [{ hasPii, count, types, entities }].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Grounded research brief.
post.description: Grounded research brief. POST { query, urls? }. Gathers sources (Wikipedia + any URLs you supply), then synthesizes a factual, cited brief: a 2-4 sentence summary, key facts, and the source list. Grounded only in the fetched sources (no free-form invention). For agent research, due diligence, and topic primers.

200.description: Normalized: items = [research brief]; sources lists what was used.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

query.description: Topic, entity, or question to research.

urls.description: Optional source URLs to ground the brief in, alongside Wikipedia.

post.summary: Render a URL as a screenshot.
post.description: Render a URL as a screenshot. POST { url, width?, height?, fullPage?, format?, quality?, waitUntil?, timeoutMs?, deviceScaleFactor?, blockAds? }. Returns raw image bytes (no JSON envelope) with X-2s-Render-Ms and X-2s-Image-Bytes headers. Viewport clamped 320-3840 × 320-2160. Timeout clamped 1-15s. Defaults: 1280×720 PNG, networkidle2 wait, ad-blocking on. Use cases: visual verification, archival, change detection, OG-card generation, RSS thumbnails.

200.description: Raw image bytes (PNG / JPEG / WebP per `format`). X-2s-Render-Ms + X-2s-Image-Bytes response headers describe the render. No JSON envelope on success.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of the viewport.

waitUntil.description: Wait condition before snap. Default networkidle2.

post.summary: Sentiment analysis. POST { text }. Returns overall...
post.description: Sentiment analysis. POST { text }. Returns overall sentiment (positive/negative/neutral/mixed), a polarity score from -1 to 1, a confidence, and a one-line rationale. For reviews, social posts, support messages, and feedback triage.

200.description: Normalized: items = [sentiment].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Summarize a webpage. POST { url, instruction? }. Returns {...
post.description: Summarize a webpage. POST { url, instruction? }. Returns { url, finalUrl, summary (1-3 sentences), keyPoints (3-7 bullets), title, audience, estimatedReadingMinutes, meta:{ truncated } }. Sibling to /api/ai/extract — use extract when you need a typed payload conforming to your own schema; use summarize when you want a ready-made digest. Supports x402 upto billing: authorize the quoted max, pay only your actual usage.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [summary] (one structured page summary: summary, keyPoints, title, audience, reading time); total = 1.

truncated.description: True if the source page was truncated before summarizing.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Translate text. POST { text, targetLanguage...
post.description: Translate text. POST { text, targetLanguage, sourceLanguage? } — language codes are BCP-47 (e.g. "en", "es-MX", "zh-Hans"). Source auto-detected when omitted. Returns { text, targetLanguage, detectedSourceLanguage, confidence (high|medium|low) }. Best for short-to-medium passages; chunk long documents on your side.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [translation] (one result: translated text, detected source language, confidence); total = 1.

detectedSourceLanguage.description: BCP-47 source language tag (echoed when supplied, detected otherwise).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

post.summary: Answer a question from the live web.
post.description: Answer a question from the live web. POST { query, topic?, maxResults? }. Runs a deep web search and returns a synthesized, citation-backed answer plus the ranked source pages (title, URL, snippet). For up-to-the-minute questions an LLM alone can't answer — news, prices, current events, recent releases. topic=news biases toward recent reporting.

200.description: Normalized: items = [{ answer, sources }].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Look up an airport by 3-letter IATA (e.g.
get.description: Look up an airport by 3-letter IATA (e.g. SFO) or 4-letter ICAO (e.g. KSFO) code. Query: code (3-5 chars, alphanumeric). Returns { airport: { id, ident, type, name, latitude, longitude, elevationFt, continent, isoCountry, isoRegion, municipality, scheduledService, icaoCode, iataCode, gpsCode, localCode, wikipediaLink } } or 404 NOT_FOUND.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [airport] (one OurAirports record); total = 1. 404 if no airport matches the code.

type.description: large_airport | medium_airport | small_airport | heliport | seaplane_base | closed.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: 3-letter IATA or 4-letter ICAO airport code (e.g. SFO, KSFO).

get.summary: Airports within a radius of a coordinate, sorted by distance.
get.description: Airports within a radius of a coordinate, sorted by distance. Query: lat (-90..90), lon (-180..180), radius_km (1-2000, default 200), limit (1-100, default 20), type (optional: large_airport|medium_airport|small_airport|heliport|seaplane_base|balloonport|closed), country (optional 2-letter ISO 3166-1), scheduled_service (optional bool, true = commercial-service airports only). Returns { query, count, airports: [{ id, ident, name, iataCode, icaoCode, type, latitude, longitude, distanceKm, ... }] }.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = airports within radius_km, sorted by ascending distance; total = null (no upstream total; query-bounded set); meta.query echoes the search.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US).

get.summary: Search the NTSB civil aviation accident & incident database...
get.description: Search the NTSB civil aviation accident & incident database (CAROL) — US events from 1962 to present plus selected foreign investigations. Filter by aircraft registration (N-number, partial match), US state (2-letter code or name), make, model, city, and/or event date range (dateFrom/dateTo as YYYY-MM-DD). At least one filter is required. Returns matching events newest-first: NTSB number, event date/type, city/state/country, aircraft registration(s)/make(s)/model(s), highest injury level, onboard & on-ground injury counts, report type/status, and a link to the official NTSB case page. Data: NTSB (U.S. public domain), live. For aviation safety research, fleet/tail-number history, incident due-diligence, and accident-trend analysis.

200.description: OK

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state, 2-letter code or full name.

get.summary: Current aviation weather observation (METAR) for one or...
get.description: Current aviation weather observation (METAR) for one or more airports. Pass ids = comma-separated ICAO station ids (e.g. KATL, EGLL, KJFK). Returns the raw METAR plus decoded fields: flight category (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR), temperature + dewpoint (°C), wind direction/speed/gust (kt), visibility, altimeter (inHg), and cloud layers. Source: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (keyless, public domain).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = METAR observations (one per station); total = count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Active in-flight weather hazard advisories (SIGMETs and...
get.description: Active in-flight weather hazard advisories (SIGMETs and AIRMETs) from the NOAA Aviation Weather Center. Returns current advisories over a lookback window (1-24h), optionally filtered by hazard (CONVECTIVE, TURB turbulence, ICE icing, IFR, MTN OBSCN mountain obscuration, ASH volcanic ash). Each advisory carries the issuing office, type (SIGMET/AIRMET/OUTLOOK), hazard, severity, valid-from/to times, affected altitude band (feet MSL), movement (direction/speed), and the raw text bulletin. Keyless, public-domain (NOAA). The active-hazard layer aviation agents need — distinct from aviation.metar (station conditions) and aviation.taf (forecasts). Not for navigation.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = active advisories (sliced to limit); total = match count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get.summary: Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) for one or more airports...
get.description: Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) for one or more airports — the official aviation forecast issued for an airport (~24–30h ahead). Pass ids = comma-separated ICAO station ids (e.g. KATL). Returns the raw TAF text + issue time. Source: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (keyless). For current conditions use aviation.metar.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = TAFs (one per station); total = count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.description: FDIC-insured US bank directory lookup. Lookup by name (fuzzy match), FDIC certificate number, RSSD ID, or state. Each record includes name + short name, web address, active flag, city/state/county/zip, established + insured dates, charter class, bank class, primary federal regulator, number of branches, assets and deposits ($1000s), and closed-date + reason for inactive institutions. Public-domain FDIC data, free.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = matched FDIC-insured institutions; total = upstream total match count; meta echoes the query + returned (this page).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state — two-letter postal abbreviation (e.g. CA) or full name.

post.description: Generate QR / Aztec / Data Matrix / PDF417 codes from structured payloads (url, wifi, vcard, vevent, email, sms, tel, geo, bitcoin, json, text). QR supports rounded or dotted modules, solid colors or linear/radial gradients, transparent backgrounds, configurable error correction, and a centered logo image (URL or data URI).

post.summary: Run up to 50 endpoint calls behind ONE x402 payment.
post.description: Run up to 50 endpoint calls behind ONE x402 payment. Price is the exact sum of the sub-call prices (no batch discount). Atomic: every sub-call must succeed or nothing is charged — the failing calls are returned and you can retry for free. Eligible sub-calls are ordinary catalog endpoints (no bearer-only, deprecated, variable-priced, or metered-upstream endpoints, and no nested batch).

200.description: One item per sub-call, in request order, each carrying that endpoint’s own response in `data`.

get.summary: Look up a gene by its official symbol (e.g.
get.description: Look up a gene by its official symbol (e.g. "TP53", "BRCA1", "CFTR") and organism (taxid, default 9606 = human), merging NCBI Gene with UniProt. Returns the gene symbol, NCBI Gene ID, full description, organism, chromosome + cytogenetic map location, alias symbols, and the curated RefSeq function summary; plus the reviewed protein from UniProt — accession, entry id, recommended protein name, length in amino acids, and the curated function description. NCBI + UniProt links. Bioinformatics, clinical-genetics research, education. Public-domain NCBI + CC-BY UniProt data. Common organism taxids: human 9606, mouse 10090, zebrafish 7955, fruit fly 7227, yeast 559292.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [{ gene }] (one gene; the best-effort UniProt protein sub-block stays inside the item); total = 1; meta.sources lists both NCBI Gene + UniProt attributions (envelope source is the primary, NCBI Gene).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Look up a protein in UniProtKB by accession (e.g.
get.description: Look up a protein in UniProtKB by accession (e.g. "P04637", "Q9Y6K9", "P0DTC2"). Returns the entry id, reviewed (Swiss-Prot) flag, recommended + alternative protein names, gene names, organism + taxid, sequence length and molecular weight, the curated function description, subcellular locations, Gene Ontology terms (id + term + aspect: biological_process / molecular_function / cellular_component), PDB structure ids, and keywords. Bioinformatics, structural biology, drug-target research, education. Gene-centric sibling: /api/bio/gene. CC-BY UniProt data.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [{ protein }] (one UniProtKB entry: names, organism, sequence, function, GO terms, PDB ids); total = 1.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Resolve any organism by scientific or common name to the...
get.description: Resolve any organism by scientific or common name to the GBIF taxonomic backbone — the canonical free reference for life on Earth. Returns the accepted scientific name + canonical name, taxonomic rank and status, the match type/confidence, the full classification (kingdom → phylum → class → order → family → genus → species), up to 8 English vernacular (common) names, the count of recorded occurrences worldwide, and the GBIF species URL. Biodiversity, ecology, education, and as a taxonomy normalizer for other pipelines. Fuzzy-matches misspellings. CC-BY GBIF data.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [{ species }] (one resolved taxon; classification + vernacular + occurrence sub-blocks stay inside the item, best-effort); total = 1.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: US Bureau of Labor Statistics time-series data.
get.description: US Bureau of Labor Statistics time-series data. Pass seriesIds = comma-separated BLS series IDs (1-10 per call), optional startYear + endYear bracket (max 10 years). Each observation: year, period (M01-M12 monthly, Q01-Q04 quarterly, A01 annual, S01/S02 semiannual), periodName, value (verbatim string from BLS) + numericValue (parsed number), latest flag, footnote texts. Common series IDs: LNS14000000 (unemployment rate), CUUR0000SA0 (CPI-U all items), CES0000000001 (nonfarm employment), LNS11300000 (labor force participation). Unauthenticated upstream — ~25 queries/day per IP.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = one entry per requested BLS series (seriesId, catalog, observations); total = number of series returned; meta.status is the upstream REQUEST_SUCCEEDED flag; meta.query echoes the request.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

Each record includes Open Library work key, title, author names + Open Library author keys, first publish year, edition count, cover image URL, sample ISBNs, publishers, languages, subject tags, fulltext flag, ebook access tier (public/borrowable/printdisabled/no_ebook), and canonical openlibrary.org URL. CC0 public-domain metadata.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.description: Brazilian company registry lookup by CNPJ (the 14-digit national company tax ID). Query: number (required; E.164 like "+14155552671" or national like "(415) 555-2671"), country (optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 like US/GB/JP — required when number is not E.164). Returns {input, valid (matches a real number range), possible (right shape/length), e164, national, international, rfc3966, country, countryCallingCode, type (mobile|fixed_line|fixed_line_or_mobile|toll_free|premium_rate|shared_cost|voip|personal_number|pager|uan|voicemail|unknown), possibleCountries[]}. Returns valid:false (not an error) for unparseable input.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [parsed phone number] (valid/possible flags, e164/national/international/rfc3966, country, type); total = 1. Returns valid:false (not a 4xx) for unparseable input.

input.description: The exact input string we received.

valid.description: True if the number matches a real, in-use number range for its country.

possible.description: True if the number is the right length/shape, even if not necessarily assigned.

e164.description: E.164 canonical form (e.g. +14155552671). Null if unparseable.

international.description: Pretty international format (e.g. "+1 415 555 2671"). Null if unparseable.

rfc3966.description: RFC 3966 tel: URI form (e.g. "tel:+14155552671"). Null if unparseable.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or null when ambiguous across +cc.

countryCallingCode.description: Country calling code with leading + (e.g. "+1"). Null if unparseable.

type.description: Number type. "unknown" when libphonenumber cannot classify.

possibleCountries.description: All ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes this number could belong to.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Phone number to normalize. E.164 (+15555551234) or a national format if country is provided.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, JP). Required when number is not in E.164 form.

get.description: Decode and validate a product barcode (GTIN / UPC-A / EAN-13 / EAN-8 / GTIN-14 / ISBN-13 / ISSN). post.summary: PUBSUB: subscribe a callbackUrl to a topic by its topicId...
post.description: PUBSUB: subscribe a callbackUrl to a topic by its topicId (the topic can belong to any wallet — you just need the id). CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: we immediately POST a one-time challenge to your callbackUrl with header X-2s-Confirmation-Token (and {type:"2s_subscription_confirmation", token} in the JSON body); to be CONFIRMED your endpoint must reply 2xx with the response body set to exactly that token, or JSON {"token":"<token>"}. Only confirmed subscribers receive published messages (this prevents subscribing a non-consenting URL). Response field "confirmed" tells you if it worked; re-call to retry. When the owner publishes, we POST the message to your callbackUrl, EIP-191-signed (verify with X-2s-Signature) and retried with backoff; a subscriber that repeatedly fails delivery is auto-disabled. Returns a subscriptionId for pubsub.unsubscribe. Up to 100 subscribers per topic, one per URL. Pay per call with x402.

200.description: Normalized: items = [the subscription]. confirmed=false means your URL did not echo the challenge token; fix it and re-call.

post.summary: WATCHER: get a signed callback the moment a crypto address...
post.description: WATCHER: get a signed callback the moment a crypto address transacts. Arm once, pay once (no account, no API key) — we watch Base, Ethereum, or Bitcoin and POST your custom payload to callbackUrl when the address sends/receives native coins, ERC-20s, or ERC-721s. Filter by direction (in/out/both), asset type, and a USD minimum (minValueUsd) to skip dust. Bounded by a 30-day / 25-fire window. Deliveries are EIP-191-signed by our published key (verify offline) and retried with exponential backoff; missed pushes are recoverable via watchers.status. Returns a watcherId.

200.description: Normalized: items = [the armed watcher].

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

chain.description: Which chain to watch: base, ethereum, or bitcoin.

callbackUrl.description: Where we POST the event. Any http(s) URL; the JSON body is signed (verify with X-2s-Signature). e.g. https://your-agent.app/hooks/wallet

direction.description: Which flows to fire on: "in" = address received, "out" = address sent, "both" = either. Default: both.

assetTypes.description: Limit to asset kinds: any of "native" (ETH/BTC), "erc20" (tokens), "erc721" (NFTs). Omit to watch all. EVM only — Bitcoin is always native. e.g. ["erc20"] for token transfers only.

minValueUsd.description: Only fire when the transfer is worth at least this many USD — filters out dust/spam. e.g. 100 ignores anything under $100. Omit to fire on any non-zero amount.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON, echoed back verbatim in every callback so you can route/identify the event on your side. e.g. {"agentId":"a1","reason":"treasury-monitor"}

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the watch stays active, in seconds. Default 2592000 (30 days), max 7776000 (90 days). e.g. 86400 = 1 day.

maxFires.description: Stop after this many callbacks. Default 25, max 1000. The watch ends at whichever comes first — maxFires or expiry.

label.description: Optional free-text tag to recognize this watcher later. e.g. "exchange-cold-wallet".

Returns temperature, feels-like, humidity, precipitation (rain/snow), cloud cover, sea-level pressure, wind speed/direction/gusts, day/night flag, and a human-readable conditions label from the WMO weather code — with local time + timezone. Global coverage (not just US — for US-only NWS data see weather.zip / weather.forecast). Source: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [current conditions]; meta = timezone + elevation + the units in effect.

time.description: Local time at the location (ISO 8601, no offset).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Official US weather forecast for a coordinate (US land +...
get.description: Official US weather forecast for a coordinate (US land + territories). Pass lat + lon. Returns the National Weather Service forecast as a list of periods — by default ~7 days of day/night periods; pass hourly=true for an hour-by-hour forecast. Each period gives the temperature + unit, wind speed/direction, chance of precipitation, and a short + detailed forecast, plus the resolved city/state and issuing office. Source: US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov), public domain. For active warnings use weather.alerts.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = forecast periods (chronological); meta = location + office + count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get.summary: Weather forecast for any coordinate worldwide, up to 16...
get.description: Weather forecast for any coordinate worldwide, up to 16 days out. Pass lat + lon; optional days (1–16, default 7), hourly=true for hour-by-hour instead of daily, and units=metric|imperial (default metric). Daily items give max/min temperature, feels-like max, precipitation total + max probability, max wind + gusts, sunrise/sunset, and human-readable conditions from the WMO weather code; hourly items give temperature, feels-like, humidity, precipitation amount + probability, wind, and conditions — all in local time. Global coverage (for the official US-only NWS forecast see weather.forecast). Source: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = forecast periods in local time (daily: date, conditions, tempMax/Min, precipSum + probability, wind max/gusts, sunrise/sunset; hourly: time, conditions, temperature, humidity, precipitation + probability, wind); meta = timezone + mode + units in effect.

time.description: Local time of the hour (ISO 8601, no offset).

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Historical daily weather for any coordinate (ERA5...
get.description: Historical daily weather for any coordinate (ERA5 reanalysis, 1940→~5 days ago). Pass lat + lon + start + end (YYYY-MM-DD, range ≤366 days). Returns per-day max/min/mean temperature (°C), precipitation total (mm) + hours, and max wind (km/h). Source: Open-Meteo archive / ECMWF ERA5 (keyless).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = daily history (chronological); total = days.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Current marine/sea-state conditions for an ocean or coastal...
get.description: Current marine/sea-state conditions for an ocean or coastal coordinate. Pass lat + lon. Returns significant wave height (m), wave direction + period, and the wind-wave and swell-wave components. Useful for surf, sailing, and coastal ops. Source: Open-Meteo marine (keyless). Returns 404 for inland points.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [current sea state]; total = 1.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Current weather conditions for a US ZIP code (temperature...
get.description: Current weather conditions for a US ZIP code (temperature, wind, humidity, conditions). Backed by the US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov) — public domain, no rate-limit pressure on commercial use.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [{ location, current }] (one ZIP-keyed current-conditions snapshot); total = 1. 404 if the ZIP is unknown.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Fetch a Wikidata entity (Q42, P31, etc.) - structured...
get.description: Fetch a Wikidata entity (Q42, P31, etc.) — structured knowledge-graph record with labels + descriptions + aliases in selectable languages, claims (property → value statements grouped by property ID), sitelinks (Wikipedia article title per language). 110M+ entities. CC0 public domain. Pass languages= as comma-separated codes (default "en") to control which language strings are included; pass maxClaimsPerProperty to cap how many statements come back per property (default 10).

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [Wikidata entity record] (labels, descriptions, aliases, claims, sitelinks); total = 1.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the record to fetch.

get.summary: Fetch a Wikipedia article summary in any of 30 supported...
get.description: Fetch a Wikipedia article summary in any of 30 supported languages. Returns title, displayTitle, lang, pageId, description, extract (plain text), extractHtml, lead image, canonical URLs, last-modified timestamp, word count, license, and an attribution string. Backed by https://<lang>.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary. Content is CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution provided.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = [Wikipedia article summary] (title, extract, extractHtml, leadImage, lastModified, wordCount, attribution); total = 1.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: English dictionary lookup via dictionaryapi.dev...
get.description: English dictionary lookup via dictionaryapi.dev (Wiktionary-sourced). Returns full entries with IPA phonetic transcription(s), audio pronunciation URLs, and meanings grouped by part of speech. Each meaning carries definitions with usage examples and per-definition synonyms + antonyms. CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0 — attribute when redistributing. Useful for vocabulary agents, writing assistants, language-learning tools.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = dictionary entries for the word (phonetics, meanings by part of speech, per-definition synonyms/antonyms); total = number of entries.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

get.summary: Related-word lookup via Datamuse.
get.description: Related-word lookup via Datamuse. Supply a seed word and a relation kind: rhymes, near-rhymes, synonyms, antonyms, means (semantic match), triggers (associated by usage), homophones, sounds-like (phonetic neighbour), spelled-like (typo / wildcard), follows-from (words that come after), preceded-by (words that come before). Returns ranked candidates with relevance score, syllable count, and grammatical tags. Useful for content generation, rhyme/poetry, vocabulary expansion, and naming agents.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = ranked related words (word, score, syllables, tags); total = null (Datamuse caps candidates without a true count); meta echoes seed word + relation + fetched count.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get.summary: World Bank Open Data - fetch a time series of a specific...
get.description: World Bank Open Data — fetch a time series of a specific indicator for a country (or 'all'). 1000+ indicators across 200+ countries, many series going back to 1960. Indicator codes are dotted-token strings, e.g., NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP current US$), SP.POP.TOTL (population total), FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (inflation CPI annual %), SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS (unemployment %), SE.ADT.LITR.ZS (adult literacy %), SP.DYN.LE00.IN (life expectancy). Country = ISO 2-letter (e.g., US, CN), ISO 3-letter (USA, CHN), or 'all'. Optional yearFrom/yearTo bracket. Each observation: country id+name, year, numeric value (may be null for missing), obsStatus. Returns indicator name + total count + pagination metadata.

200.description: Normalized envelope: items = indicator observations (countryId, year, value); total = upstream total observation count; page = current page; meta carries indicator id/name + query echo.

total.description: Total matching rows upstream; null when unknown.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name or ISO country code.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.
